text.title: ASP.NET Core Patterns Procedure
text.summary: End-to-end 7-step procedure to apply ASP.NET Core Patterns. Each step pairs typed input + bounded action + named output + decision-gate, and names the rules from `01-core-rules.xml` it satisfies. Steps are sequential unless explicitly marked parallel.

step.name: scaffold-feature-folders
step.action: Generate Features/<Name>/ with controller, service, repository, DTOs; the controller calls exactly one service method and holds no DbContext (controller-calls-service-only).
step.decision-gate: Output present and matches `content/02-output-contract.xml` schema for this stage; otherwise block.

step.name: wire-di-and-pipeline
step.action: Register services with correct lifetimes — DbContext scoped via AddDbContext<T>(), no scoped dependency captured by a singleton (dbcontext-scoped-lifetime). Order the middleware UseExceptionHandler → UseHttpsRedirection → UseAuthentication → UseAuthorization → MapControllers (middleware-order-authn-before-authz) and set RequireAuthenticatedUser() as the fallback policy (authorize-by-default).
step.decision-gate: Output present and matches `content/02-output-contract.xml` schema for this stage; otherwise block.

step.name: thread-cancellation-tokens
step.action: Add CancellationToken as last param on every async method; thread it to the EF Core calls (cancellation-token-threaded).
step.decision-gate: Output present and matches `content/02-output-contract.xml` schema for this stage; otherwise block.

step.name: adopt-record-dtos-and-mappers
step.action: Define DTOs as records with required init properties and map at the service boundary (record-dtos-at-boundary). Prefer Mapperly; where AutoMapper is already in place, define profiles and add an AssertConfigurationIsValid() test (mapper-verified-at-build). Inject TimeProvider instead of DateTime.UtcNow (timeprovider-injected).
step.decision-gate: Output present and matches `content/02-output-contract.xml` schema for this stage; otherwise block.

step.name: return-problemdetails
step.action: Replace ad-hoc 500s with ProblemDetails; register a global IExceptionHandler with AddProblemDetails() + UseExceptionHandler() (problem-details-error-contract). Do not introduce a second error style alongside it (no-mixed-error-handling-styles).
step.decision-gate: Output present and matches `content/02-output-contract.xml` schema for this stage; otherwise block.

step.name: tune-query-discipline
step.action: Add AsNoTracking() to every read query (asnotracking-on-reads); replace implicit navigation access with .Include()/.ThenInclude() and keep lazy loading off (eager-include-no-lazy-loading); switch list endpoints to keyset pagination (keyset-pagination); wrap multi-step writes in an explicit transaction (explicit-transaction-multi-step-writes).
step.decision-gate: Output present and matches `content/02-output-contract.xml` schema for this stage; otherwise block.

step.name: wire-tests
step.action: Stand up WebApplicationFactory<Program> + Testcontainers Postgres and drop any EF InMemory reference (testcontainers-not-ef-inmemory). Unit tests use MockBehavior.Strict with explicit Verify, or defer to the integration suite (strict-mocks-or-integration-tests).
step.decision-gate: Output present and matches `content/02-output-contract.xml` schema for this stage; otherwise block.

section.title: Failure handling
section.p: If a decision-gate blocks, do NOT proceed to the next step. Surface the blockage to the owner with the specific input that did not satisfy the gate. Resume only after the input is corrected.

section.title: Decision gates
section.p: Between steps, consult `content/06-decision-tree.xml` if the observed signal does not match the expected output. The decision tree always terminates at a rule id from `01-core-rules.xml` or at `skip-this-methodology`.
